as_told.title: Eric Wargo's Time Loops on precognition

plain: A writer named Eric Wargo argues in his book Time Loops that people can sense events in their own future before they happen, and offers a theory of how: the brain works as a kind of hybrid of an ordinary and a quantum computer that can reach "future knowledge states". Michels brings up the book in several episodes, saying he had Wargo on his show, and in one he stresses instead Wargo's idea of the "long body", a person stretched out across time. If true, it would mean the future can leak back into the present mind.
